entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Ah, welcome. Will you be participating[n]in our stunning Battle Arena?

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Allow me to confirm something[n]before I begin explaining... Do you[n]currently have [clr 2]10,000[clr 27] coins?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, no?

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Well that won't do at all.[n]Please come back once you've [n]won [clr 2]10,000[clr 27] coins.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Of course! Our teamwork's gonna[n]take down this arena of yours!

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Ah, now that won't do. This is a series[n]of honest one-on-one battles.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Don't tell me...

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Correct, only one can participate.[n]You'll need to choose someone to[n]act as your representative.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: The entry fee for this[n]event is [clr 2]10,000[clr 27] coins.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: However, if you manage to succeed in[n]the trials, you will be granted ten times[n]that: [clr 2]100,000[clr 27] coins.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, what!? That's enough to[n]get us across that bridge! Come[n]on, we need to do this!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hm... This feels like a trap to me.[n]An amount that high would[n]certainly ensure great danger.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But failure to infiltrate this Palace[n]will be the end of us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So we don't got a choice...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Very well. In that case, Joker should[n]be the one to participate.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We don't know what kind of enemies[n]may appear, so his high level of[n]adaptability will be vital here.
Leave it to me.
If I have to...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are you sure about this?[n]You will have to fight alone...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But... that's why Joker's the one doing it,[n]right...? I mean, I understand why...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: J-Just be careful, okay? Don't do[n]anything reckless in there.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm glad you understand.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I think I can at least provide[n]backup from the sidelines. You[n]won't be alone, Joker!

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Has your mind been made up?[n]The battles will begin once you enter.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Now then, shall you challenge[n]the imposing Battle Arena?
Let's do this.
I need to prepare first.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Oh...? In that case, please head[n]onward into the ring.

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: The entry fee and appropriate[n]prize total shall be calculated[n]at the [clr 2]end of the game[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Now then... prepare to know the true[n]meaning of agony. *chuckle*

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Only you will be able to continue[n]from here onward. We'll be cheering[n]from the stands, so best of luck!

entries.speaker: Shadow Dealer
entries.en: Oh, that's fine. There is no need[n]to overexert yourself. Come back[n]if you ever find the courage...
